name: Server - Agent Card Endpoint
description: Serves the Agent Card that tells other agents who you are and where to send A2A requests. Needs Camunda 8.9 or later with the standard connectors runtime. See the blueprint README for setup.

properties.label: Webhook ID
properties.description: Clients read the Agent Card from your connectors URL followed by /inbound/ and this ID.

properties.label: Public RPC URL
properties.description: The full HTTPS URL of the A2A webhook, including the path (for example, https://example.com/inbound/a2a). Clients use it to send requests, so it must be reachable from them. It is public, not a credential.

pattern.message: Enter the full HTTPS URL of the A2A webhook, including the path

properties.label: Agent Card
properties.description: Describes your agent to other agents. Update the name, description, and skills to match your agent. Keep the public URL field and the disabled capabilities.
properties.value: ={rpcUrl: get value(correlation.activatedElement.properties, "inbound.publicRpcUrl"), response: if rpcUrl instance of string and matches(rpcUrl, "^https://[^ /]+/[^ ]*$") then {statusCode: 200, headers: {"Content-Type": "application/json"}, body: {name: "A2A blueprint agent", version: "0.1.0", description: "Example agent from the Camunda A2A blueprint. properties.label: Result variable
properties.description: Name of variable to store the response in. Details in the documentation.

properties.label: Result expression
properties.description: Variable that holds the request data. Leave empty to skip.
